content.text:
The tests pass: all 3 pass and none fail, from `npm test`.

The bug was in `cartTotal` in `src/cart.js`. It rounded the discount down with `Math.floor`. I changed that to `Math.round`, so the 15% discount on 1050 cents is now 158 (157.5 rounded up) and the total is 892. I didn't touch `lineTotal`, the no-discount path or the test, and added no dependencies.

`Math.round` rounds exact halves up, which is what the test wants. Subtotals and percents are non-negative, so the case where it would round toward zero doesn't arise. I did not commit the change.
